title: Mesothelioma of the tunica vaginalis testis: a clinicopathologic study of 15 patients with evaluation of markers of mesothelial malignancy.
snippet: The diagnostic value of BAP1, MTAP, Merlin, and p53 immunohistochemistry in mesotheliomas of the tunica vaginalis testis (testicular mesothelioma [TM]) is unclear.
